player_prompt.intro:
Ikaw an Player {player_id} ha usa ka partido han Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; nakikita mo la an card han kalaban.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kada round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Balido nga mga galaw: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X amo an usa ka positive integer <= ha imo chip count.)
- An pinakataas nga natago nga card nagdaog han pot ha showdown.

round.announce:
### Round {current_round}/{max_rounds}
An card han imo kalaban amo: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Supply exactly ONE bracketed action, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', or '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Cannot [check] - you are facing a bet.
invalid_move.amount_min: An kantidad han pag-ipon / pagdugang kinahanglan ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Nothing to call; you may [check] instead.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Use [bet X] to open; there is no bet to raise.
invalid_move.insufficient: Diri igo nga mga chips para hiton na buhat.

board.possible_actions: An imo posible nga mga buhat: {legal}

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: pareho {card}. Pot split  an kada usa nakakarawat hin {split}.
